title: CompHairHead: One-shot 3D Avatars with Deformable Hair
summary: A research project for generating high-fidelity, animatable 3D head avatars from a single 2D portrait. It decouples the reconstruction into a bald facial mesh and dynamic hair represented by 3D Gaussian Splats, enabling realistic physics and easy hairstyle swapping.
research_notes: Optimized for Apple Silicon (M1-M4) using Metal/MPS; utilizes SAM2 for hair-face segmentation and FLAME for facial expressions.

evolution.summary: Released in April 2026 as a successor to 3DGH, introducing Position-Based Dynamics (PBD) for hair simulation within a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework. It remains the current state-of-the-art for physically realistic, one-shot avatar animation.
